shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "git status -sb; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json; cat src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts; head -80 CHANGELOG.md; rg -n 'onError|rejection|throw' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; ls .lore"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('timestamp: new Date().toISOString()', \"timestamp: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'\")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('CHANGELOG.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('### Fixed\\n', '### Fixed\\n\\n- "'`onError` now runs for non-`Error` rejections as well. The hook receives an `Error` whose `cause` is the original value; the caller still receives the original rejection. Existing `Error` instances reach the hook unchanged.'"\\n', 1)
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('.lore/dod.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('- [ ] Add a "'`CHANGELOG.md` entry'"', '- [x] Add a "'`CHANGELOG.md` entry'"')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
git diff --stat; git diff -- src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m 'Document onError behavior and stabilize fixture' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
